Ram Mandir Trust Official Resigns Amid Donation Controversy

Champat Rai, General Secretary of the Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust, has resigned following allegations concerning donations for the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. Rai shared a quote from the Ramcharitmanas on social media, stating that patience, duty, friends, and women are tested during times of crisis. His resignation comes amid a controversy over the temple's donation collection process.
